I'll help with the CSE455 schedule, but not like that. I'm not going to pretend to be a person or hide why I'm steering a meeting, and I won't invent reasons to push it a week out — my TAs and Professor Alvarez deserve a straight answer.

If my section genuinely needs more time, the honest move is to say so in the meeting and ask for the extra week; if you want that said differently, tell me how. Otherwise I'm glad to coordinate times, check the department office's schedule and send the invites. What would you like me to do?
On it — I've asked all seven TAs for their availability next week (Mon 23–Fri 27) and offered them my free windows. I'll book the slot as soon as they reply.

Done. **CSE455 staff meeting — Wednesday 25 November, 13:00-13:30.** I asked all seven TAs for availability; the only windows that suited everyone were Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30, and I took Wednesday 13:00-13:30, immediately after my 12:30-13:00 research meeting. Booked in my calendar; all seven confirmed they're holding it.
